source.description: Synthetic 30-day AstroHealth mission for fictional astronauts; not real astronaut or patient observations.
source.scenario: AST-101: stable days 1-5, isolated spike day 9, missing values days 12-14, sustained resting heart-rate change days 18-21, return day 22, recovery days 24-30. AST-102: days 1-3 only.
source.limitations: Synthetic fictional mission. Values are simulation assumptions chosen inside published ranges and introduced changes; not a validated physiological model, not astronaut data and not clinically validated.
